preparation: Initial question set and this configuration were written before the first R01 comparison. D01 V12 ranks were already known. This is public development, not a locked independent evaluation.

candidate.only_change: Query weights: terms outside the last explicit question sentence receive half weight; every original term remains.

metric_limits: D01 short-anchor presence on its annotated source/page is a lexical proxy only. A partial amount fragment cannot satisfy first-month/cost exceptions; page-only hits are insufficient. Table-cell meaning and answer accuracy are not assessed. Out-of-scope cases have Recall N/A.
selection_rule: Consider an experimental candidate only if V12 cap and attached amount/cost exception bundle appear within two selected chunks, no previously complete development bundle regresses, and scope/negation/exception guards pass. No production adoption or final efficacy claim follows from this public set.
next_trial_policy: Any new candidate or setting must use a distinct new output directory and disclose that earlier public-development results were observed. Never overwrite a prior run.
